# Instructions for accurately documenting a failed industrial safety audit

1. Start with the inspection records.

completion:
Do not trust any of the records, no matter how well they've been maintained on paper or in software.
3. Do not trust your coworkers, no matter how good they are at their jobs or how old and dusty they look in photographs.
4. Do not trust the company's lawyers, no matter how long they've been in business.
5. Ask your coworkers to write down the name of every piece of safety equipment that may or may not be involved in the failed inspection.
6. Do not trust your coworkers to use the correct spelling of the equipment's name. Use the appropriate hyphenation and punctuation.

8. Ask your coworkers to write down the name of every employee that may or may not have operated or maintained it.
